system.description:
Arc-Deflection: Once per long rest,
spend a Hope to negate the damage of
an attack targeting you or an ally within
Very Close range.
Routine Lock: Target a object within Far
range. That object’s operating routine
is interrupted exactly where it is until
your next rest. If a creature tries to
reactivate it, make an Interface Roll
against them to maintain this protocol.
Fire-Wall: Make an Interface Roll (15).
On a success, create a wall of hostile
signal, burning plasma, hard-light code,
or automated suppression between
two points within Far range. All
creatures in its path must choose a
side to be on, and anything that
subsequently passes through the wall
takes 4d10+3 techno damage.
